chunks: O Allah, forgive me what I had promised to myself, but did not find its fulfilment with me.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali ask Allah to forgive in this supplication from Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this supplication from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) seeks divine pardon for 'vows to oneself' (nadhr al-nafs), a concept in Shia jurisprudence where one binds oneself to an act without explicitly addressing God. This highlights the psychological and spiritual weight of self-imposed obligations, emphasizing that even unfulfilled personal commitments require Allah's mercy. The supplication reflects the Imam's meticulous attention to detail in worship and his awareness of the nuances between formal vows and personal promises.
